purpose: Compile matched bitmap and direct-row native modules with corrected PSRAM policy; bounded source checks only
resources: Serial native compiler/linker then ordinary bounded source checks; expected under512MiB; no emulator
duration: Under2min expected,180s per subprocess,10min finite envelope
cleanup: Join owned children, preserve logs, release with work-stopped and cleanup-complete

policy.builds: Automatically granted FIFO, one compile job at a time; no manager approval or 10% CPU gate.
policy.heavy: Emulators, CFD/solvers and other heavy work require explicit Author authorization, manager admission, and start/end chat notices to pi5-manager.
policy.build_cleanup: After owned children stop, release using --work-stopped --cleanup-complete; no manager handback or host-wide quiet test.
policy.authorization_limit: A supplied record documents authorization; this same-account helper cannot authenticate human authorship.

release_observation.disposition: Owner confirms all owned build children stopped and cleanup complete; no global quiet claim

automatic_build_grant.purpose: One MOS frontend for98 missing native checks, unchanged module; no emulator on Pi
automatic_build_grant.cleanup: Join owned build children and retain outputs
